所有接口免费，仅支持 GET，只读取密钥所属学校用户的数据。\n\nBase U:
All endpoints are free, accept GET only, and read only the key owner's school data.

Base URL: %s/v1. Header: Authorization: Bearer <application-key>. Use school SSO to manage applications in the console. SSO cookies do not replace API keys.

Default accounts and new applications allow %d requests per minute and %d per day. All applications owned by a user share the account quota. Per-user concurrency is %d and burst capacity is %d requests/second. Account, application, and endpoint settings apply together. Minute windows last 60 seconds from the first request. Daily quotas reset at 00:00 UTC (08:00 China Standard Time). Admitted requests consume quota, including errors from campus services. Authentication and gateway rejections do not consume request quota, but may occupy rate-limit windows.

Only the documented query parameters are accepted. refresh, automatic, and waitForSync are unsupported. Unknown or duplicate parameters return 400. page and pageSize are capped at 100; buildingIds accepts up to 5 values.

Successful JSON responses contain success/data and sometimes meta. Images and attachments are binary. Examples illustrate structure only; obtain term and resource identifiers from your own responses. Responses are limited to 16 MiB. Record X-Request-Id for troubleshooting. Online documentation: %s/api-reference.
在控制台创建应用后获取密钥；仅能访问该应用被授予的权限。: Create an application in the console to obtain a key. The key can access only its granted scopes.
